descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you interested in financial markets and curious how data turns into meaningful client insights?
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing information and learning new tools?
Are you looking for an opportunity to gain real hands‑on experience in a global organisation?
We’re looking for an intern to join our Client Reporting team who will support day‑to‑day reporting activities and develop practical skills in client reporting and data analysis.
In this role, you will:
• Support the preparation of client reports, helping deliver accurate and insightful information to international clients
• Work with data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy of outputs
• Learn how reporting processes work end‑to‑end and contribute to meeting tight deadlines
• Collaborate with team members to deliver high‑quality outputs and respond to client and internal requests
• Help identify inconsistencies in data and support investigation and resolution
• Contribute ideas to improve processes, tools and reporting quality
• Gain hands‑on experience through real business tasks and projects, building practical knowledge of reporting in Asset Management
